captions.detailed: A 3D-printed multi-well plate featuring a 2x3 grid of tall, cylindrical wells. The wells are hollow with thin walls and flat bottoms, connected to each other by small rectangular bridging beams near their lower half. On the outer edges, small rectangular block features are attached, one of which contains a small hollow square recess.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric multi-well plate without an outer skirt using OpenSCAD. The user should be able to customize the number of rows and columns, the well inner diameter, well depth, wall thickness, bottom thickness, and spacing between well centers, with thin rectangular connector blocks bridging adjacent wells.
captions.factory: The script defines parameters like NumRows, NumCols, WellDiameter, WellDepth, and WellCenterSpacing. It uses nested for-loops to generate the grid of wells, modeling each well by subtracting a smaller cylinder from a larger one (difference of cylinders). The program places connecting rectangular prisms (cubes) between adjacent wells using translation offsets, and adds corner block features at the grid boundaries using boolean difference operations.
